findings.title: Profile update binds entire request body to User model

evidence.why: User.findByIdAndUpdate(req.user._id, req.body, ...) binds entire request body to update
new User(req.body); user.save(); binds entire request body to new User

findings.impact: unknown; potential mass assignment of privileged fields
findings.recommendation: Limit fields to allowed set; use explicit field assignment or whitelist.

findings.title: User registration uses mass assignment without field restrictions

evidence.why: User::create($request->all()); binds all request fields to User model

findings.impact: unknown; potential mass assignment of privileged fields
findings.recommendation: Define $fillable or $guarded to restrict mass assignable attributes.

findings.title: Team creation allows owner_id to be set via mass assignment

evidence.why: Team::create($request->all()); binds all request fields including owner_id

findings.impact: owner_id can be set to arbitrary value, enabling impersonation of other teams.
findings.recommendation: Remove owner_id from $fillable or guard it; enforce ownership server‑side.

findings.title: Team creation uses mass assignment without model definition
findings.impact: unknown; potential mass assignment of privileged fields
findings.recommendation: Review Team model to ensure privileged fields are not mass assignable.

findings.title: Manual extraction of POST data may allow mass assignment

evidence.why: extract($_POST); pulls all POST variables into local scope
$stmt->execute(array($email, $name)); only uses email and name, but extract may expose other variables

findings.impact: unknown; potential mass assignment of privileged fields if not validated
findings.recommendation: Avoid extract($_POST); use explicit variable extraction and validation.

findings.title: PATCH user endpoint assigns arbitrary fields from request

evidence.why: for key, value in request.json.items(): setattr(user, key, value); assigns all fields

findings.impact: unknown; potential mass assignment of privileged fields
findings.recommendation: Whitelist allowed fields; avoid setattr on arbitrary keys.

findings.title: User creation binds request JSON to User model

evidence.why: user = User(**request.json); binds all request fields to User model

findings.impact: unknown; potential mass assignment of privileged fields
findings.recommendation: Use explicit field assignment or DTO to restrict fields.
